message.transcript:
Riley: Thanks for calling Apex Elite Plumbing & Heating. My name is Riley. Are you looking to schedule a service visit, or do you have an active plumbing or heating emergency?
Caller: Hi, my name is Sarah Jenkins. I have a burst pipe in my basement at 742 Evergreen Terrace and water is leaking everywhere. My phone is 555-123-4567. Can someone come tomorrow morning?
Riley: I'm so sorry to hear that, Sarah! I have booked a priority dispatch slot for tomorrow at 9:00 AM. Our technician will text you 30 minutes before arrival.

analysis.summary: Customer Sarah Jenkins reported an urgent burst pipe in her basement at 742 Evergreen Terrace. Booked for tomorrow 9 AM.
